title: Scout Runtime Learning Candidate
description: Defines a governed proposal for durable runtime learning. A Learning Candidate is evidence-backed but is not accepted truth until evaluated, approved, implemented, verified, and optionally converted into a Memory Record.

examples.title: Bind Product Claims to Authoritative Evidence During Generation

origin.origin_summary: A Xiaohongshu draft contained an unsupported product claim.

learning_statement.problem_statement: The generation skill may create unsupported product claims and rely on downstream QA.
learning_statement.proposed_learning: All factual product and process claims should map to authoritative knowledge before final Skill Output.
learning_statement.expected_benefit: Reduce unsupported claims, rework, quality failures, and brand risk.
learning_statement.current_behavior: Claims are generated first and validated after drafting.
learning_statement.desired_behavior: Claims are finalized only when linked to approved knowledge.
learning_statement.short_form: No unsupported product claim may enter final Skill Output.
learning_statement.rationale: Prevention is more efficient than downstream correction.
counterexamples: Purely expressive copy without factual claims.

items.description: The exception documents an unsupported claim and correction.
The quality report classified the claim as a blocking failure.
A replay with the guardrail produced zero unsupported claims.

evidence.summary: Exception, quality finding, and replay support the rule.

analysis.analysis_summary: A low-cost generation-stage check can prevent meaningful quality failures.
alternative_explanations: The incident may have been isolated.
assumptions: Approved knowledge is available before generation.

applicable_contexts.name: BUXA Product Content
applicable_contexts.rationale: Product claims must align with approved Product Passports.
constraints: Applies to factual product, manufacturing, installation, certification, performance, and service claims.

excluded_contexts: Pure moodboard generation without factual claims.

change_risks.description: Strict evidence binding could make copy rigid.
change_risks.mitigation: Bind only factual claims, not tone or narrative.

no_change_risk.mitigation: Implement the guardrail and retain QA.

risk_assessment.risk_summary: Low implementation risk and high quality benefit.

change_proposal.proposed_change: Require every factual claim to reference authoritative knowledge.
change_proposal.rollback_plan: Revert prompt and output contract if tests fail.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Ten replays produce zero unsupported factual claims.

criteria.rationale: Multiple strong sources support the rule.

evaluation.evaluation_summary: Strongly supported, low risk, and testable.

decision.rationale: Meets evidence, value, risk, and testability thresholds.

verification.verification_summary: Guardrail prevented unsupported claims without regression.

memory_recommendation.proposed_memory: For BUXA product content, every factual product or process claim must be traceable to approved authoritative knowledge before final output.

governance.deprecation_trigger: Review if Product Passport or claim-validation architecture changes.

timeline.summary: Candidate created from a resolved quality exception.

confidence.basis: Supported by the referenced Runtime evidence and validation results.
